description: This file contains the implementation of a generic object pooling pattern with a specific focus on pooling StringBuilder instances. It defines a generic ObjectPool class with methods for allocating and freeing objects, leak detection features, and a specialized StringBuilderPool class for reusing StringBuilder objects efficiently.

classes.name: ObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe generic object pool with a fixed size, supporting object reuse and leak detection.

classes.name: StringBuilderPool
classes.description: A specialized object pool for StringBuilder instances to optimize string concatenation performance.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool for future reuse.

methods.name: CreatePool
methods.description: Creates a new ObjectPool instance with a specified size.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Obtains a StringBuilderPool instance from the pool.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources and optionally returns the StringBuilder to the pool.
